notice.preflight:
================  TEST ON A REAL RIG: READ BEFORE GOING ON  ================
 1. The ANTENNA is DISCONNECTED: a DUMMY LOAD (50 ohms, adequate power rating) is connected.
 2. The rig's transmit POWER is at MINIMUM (5 W or less).
 3. VOX is off. The rig's INTERNAL TRANSMIT TIME-OUT TIMER (TOT) is set
    (1 to 3 minutes): it is the last safety net if the computer, the software or the USB cable fails.
 4. WINDOWS SOUNDS (notifications) do NOT go to the rig's sound card: neither as default
    output, nor system sounds, nor another program (WSJT-X, HRD...) using the rig.
 5. You stay NEAR THE RIG: you can switch off the power or disconnect the load at any time.
 6. Your licence allows you to transmit on the displayed frequency.
============================================================================
notice.rx_only:
================  RECEIVE-ONLY TEST: NO TRANSMISSION  ================
 The rig is read back; the frequency, the filter width and the spectrum screen are changed then restored.
 You stay near the rig: two steps ask you to act on it (MENU then EXIT keys).
======================================================================
